Frequently Asked Questions (TikTok Shop Fees)

Does TikTok Shop US charge an extra credit card processing fee on top of 6%?

No. Standard payment processing is bundled into TikTok Shop US’s 6% referral fee, though creator affiliate commissions (typically 10%–25%) and FBT fulfillment fees stack separately.

What happens to TikTok referral fees when a customer requests a refund?

TikTok credits back the referral fee minus a 20% refund administration retention (capped at $5.00 per SKU).
